metadata.name: HeinPlay
metadata.description: 海因影视，用于lunatv（moontv）的Android TV客户端，以及手机、Windows等多平台客户端，本地缓存比网页版更流畅的访问速度

summary.zh: 基于Flutter开发的跨平台LunaTV（原moontv）影视客户端，覆盖Android TV、手机、Windows、Linux（适配Steam Deck掌机）等多端，TV端优化遥控器焦点导航，支持影视点播、电视直播回放、双服务器自动测速切换、IPv6优先解析等功能，本地缓存访问体验更流畅。
summary.en: A cross-platform LunaTV (formerly moontv) media client built with Flutter, supporting Android TV, mobile, Windows, Linux (optimized for Steam Deck handheld) and more. The TV version is optimized for remote control focus navigation, featuring on-demand video, live TV with time-shift playback, automatic dual-server speed test switching, IPv6-first resolution, and smoother local cache access.

metadata.name: Open-Box
metadata.description: OpenWrt 一体化透明代理方案:一条命令装完 sing-box 内核 + 管理面板,浏览器打开即用

metadata.name: Navo
metadata.description: Independent, unofficial Telegram client for Android, Windows, and macOS. Sign in with your existing Telegram account — built with Flutter on TDLib.

summary.zh: Navo是基于Flutter与TDLib开发的独立非官方Telegram客户端，支持Android、iOS、Windows、macOS四大主流平台，用户可使用现有Telegram账号直接登录，无需额外注册，提供多端一致的即时通讯体验。
summary.en: Navo is an independent unofficial Telegram client built with Flutter and TDLib, supporting Android, iOS, Windows and macOS platforms. Users can log in with their existing Telegram accounts without extra registration, and enjoy a consistent instant messaging experience across multiple devices.

metadata.name: edgeever
metadata.description: Open-source, AI-native knowledge base & Evernote alternative with native MCP. Zero-cost on Cloudflare or Docker.

summary.zh: EdgeEver是开源AI原生知识库与Evernote替代方案，保留经典三栏笔记布局，原生支持MCP协议，可零成本部署于Cloudflare或Docker环境，全栈开源，万级笔记仍流畅，适配多端知识管理与AI智能体集成场景，解决现有笔记工具付费、臃肿、同步难的痛点。
summary.en: EdgeEver is an open-source, AI-native knowledge base and Evernote alternative. It retains the classic three-pane note layout, natively supports MCP protocol, can be deployed at zero cost on Cloudflare or Docker, is fully open-source, remains smooth with over 10,000 notes, suitable for multi-device knowledge management and AI agent integration, solving pain points of paid, bloated, and sync-difficult existing note tools.

metadata.name: EcoHub
metadata.description: 一款高性能、现代化支持的全栈多源影视采集聚合系统，用于搭建自己的私人影视库，支持Tvbox与Ecohub原生应用

summary.zh: EcoHub是一款高性能现代化全栈多源影视聚合系统，用于快速搭建私人影视库，基于Go+Next.js技术栈，支持Docker一键部署，兼容TVBox、影视仓订阅及MacCMS接口，配套鸿蒙/安卓客户端，提供自动化采集与管理后台，实现流畅观影体验，片源由用户自行配置采集接口。
summary.en: EcoHub is a high-performance, modern full-stack multi-source video aggregation system for building private media libraries. Built with Go and Next.js, it supports one-click Docker deployment, works with TVBox, VOD warehouse subscriptions and MacCMS interfaces, and offers HarmonyOS/Android clients, automated collection and a management dashboard for smooth viewing. Video sources are user-configured via custom interfaces.

metadata.name: zhangxuefeng-skill
metadata.description: 张雪峰.skill — 张雪峰的认知操作系统。高考志愿/考研/职业规划的实战思维框架。由女娲.skill生成。

summary.zh: 本仓库为基于张雪峰公开内容蒸馏的可运行AI思维框架Skill，覆盖高考志愿填报、考研择校、职业规划等核心场景，提炼5个核心心智模型与8条决策启发式，适配多AI运行时，为用户提供接地气的升学就业决策参考。
summary.en: This repository is a runnable AI thinking framework Skill distilled from Zhang Xuefeng's public content, covering core scenarios like college entrance exam application, postgraduate school selection, and career planning. It distills 5 core mental models and 8 decision heuristics, supports multiple AI runtimes, and provides practical guidance for users' education and employment decisions.

metadata.name: LetRecovery
metadata.description: 一款免费开源的 Windows 系统重装工具

summary.value: 一款免费非商用开源的Windows系统重装工具，基于Rust开发，支持WIM/ESD/ISO/GHO等多格式系统镜像的部署、备份，兼容BitLocker加密盘处理、驱动注入、内置Aria2多线程加速的在线镜像下载等全流程系统维护功能，适配桌面端与WinPE双端运行，覆盖UEFI/Legacy启动模式。

metadata.name: czkawka
metadata.description: Multi functional app to find duplicates, empty folders, similar images etc.

summary.zh: Czkawka是基于内存安全Rust开发的开源免费跨平台文件清理工具套件，核心库可复用，提供桌面GUI（Krokiet/旧版GTK4 Czkawka）、CLI、安卓端多前端，支持重复文件、空文件夹、相似媒体、损坏文件等15类文件扫描清理，多线程高效，无广告无数据收集。
summary.en: Czkawka is an open-source, free, cross-platform file cleanup toolkit built with memory-safe Rust. It provides a reusable core library and multiple frontends including desktop GUI (Krokiet/legacy GTK4 Czkawka), CLI and Android app. It supports 15+ file scanning features like duplicate files, empty folders, similar media and corrupted files, with high-performance multithreading, no ads or data collection.

metadata.name: clash-verge-rev
metadata.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience

summary.zh: Clash Verge Rev是基于Tauri 2与Rust开发的跨平台代理客户端，内置Clash Meta内核，支持Windows、macOS、Linux三大系统，提供可视化节点规则编辑、TUN虚拟网卡模式、主题自定义、配置备份同步等功能，为用户提供轻量稳定的代理管理体验。
summary.en: Clash Verge Rev is a cross-platform proxy client built on Tauri 2 and Rust, featuring a built-in Clash Meta kernel. It supports Windows, macOS and Linux, and provides functions such as visual node and rule editing, TUN virtual network card mode, theme customization, and configuration backup and sync, delivering a lightweight and stable proxy management experience for users.

metadata.name: gitpush
metadata.description: an AI Github Rlease Tracker Powered by Cloudflare

summary.:: GitPush是基于Cloudflare生态的AI驱动GitHub Release追踪工具，可自动监控指定仓库的版本更新，借助DeepSeek R1生成更新摘要并推送邮件通知。依托Cloudflare Workers、Workflows等无服务器服务实现轻量部署，支持定时巡检与手动触发，适用于开发者追踪依赖项目、关注开源项目动态等场景。
summary.en: GitPush is an AI-powered GitHub Release Tracker built on the Cloudflare ecosystem. It automatically monitors specified repositories for version updates, generates concise update summaries via DeepSeek R1, and delivers notifications via email. Leveraging Cloudflare's serverless services including Workers and Workflows, it supports lightweight deployment, scheduled inspections and manual triggers, suitable for developers to track dependency projects and follow open-source project updates.

metadata.name: stremio-web
metadata.description: Stremio - Freedom to Stream

summary.zh: Stremio Web是Stremio流媒体中心的官方Web端，基于React开发UI，核心逻辑由Rust编译为WebAssembly在Web Worker中运行。支持插件扩展内容源、多端同步、Chromecast投屏、自定义字幕，可安装为PWA，实现跨平台流媒体聚合与播放。

metadata.name: ai-coding-welfare
metadata.description: AI Coding 福利站导航：免费白嫖 Claude Code / Codex 的中转站与公益站合集，含额度、模型、价格自动更新与一键配置脚本

summary.zh: 本仓库为AI编程工具免费资源导航站，聚合Claude Code、Codex等AI编程工具的中转/公益站资源，自动同步额度、模型、价格信息，提供一键配置脚本、多维度站点横评与可用性历史查询，支持社区投稿补充站点，降低开发者使用AI编程工具的门槛。
summary.en: This repository serves as a navigation hub for free AI coding tool resources, aggregating relay and public welfare stations for tools including Claude Code and Codex. It automatically synchronizes quota, model, and pricing data, provides one-click configuration scripts, multi-dimensional station comparisons, and availability history queries, and supports community submissions to enrich station resources, lowering the barrier for developers to access AI coding tools.

metadata.name: x-ui-pro
metadata.description: XUI-PRO nginx reverse proxy with ws/grpc/httpupgrade/splithttp,xray protocol support: vless,vmess,trojan,shadowsocks panel cloudflare ssl,xtls,ssr,v2fly,v2ray installer bypass restrictions sing-box,shadowtls,reality,tunnel,gfw tor warp wireguard geoip tuic clash vpn mihomo psiphon hy2 oneclick argo bbr wstunnel anticensorship⚡🛡️

summary.zh: x-ui-pro是面向Linux服务器的反审查代理一键部署工具，整合x-ui、v2rayA、WARP、Tor、Psiphon等多组件，支持VLESS、VMess、Trojan等主流代理协议，通过nginx实现WebSocket/GRPC等流量转发，提供Cloudflare CDN适配、自动SSL、假网站伪装、多域名管理等功能，可快速搭建低检测率的代理服务。
summary.en: XUI-PRO is a one-click deployment tool for anti-censorship proxy services on Linux servers. It integrates components like x-ui, v2rayA, WARP, Tor and Psiphon, supports mainstream proxy protocols including VLESS, VMess and Trojan, leverages nginx for WebSocket/GRPC traffic forwarding, and offers features such as Cloudflare CDN compatibility, auto SSL renewal, fake website camouflage and multi-domain management to quickly build low-detection proxy services.

metadata.name: xiaozhi-esp32
metadata.description: An MCP-based chatbot | 一个基于MCP的聊天机器人

summary.zh: 这是基于MCP协议的ESP32端AI语音聊天机器人“小智”，集成Qwen/DeepSeek等大模型能力，支持离线语音唤醒、多模态交互（语音/视觉/显示）、设备端与云端MCP扩展，可控制外设与智能家居，适配138+开发板及WiFi/4G等多网络模式，是端侧AI交互与物联网控制的轻量落地方案。
summary.en: This is an ESP32-based AI voice chatbot "XiaoZhi" built on the MCP protocol, integrated with large model capabilities of Qwen/DeepSeek. It supports offline voice wake-up, multimodal interaction (voice/vision/display), device-side and cloud-side MCP extensions for peripheral and smart home control, adapts to 138+ development boards and multi-network modes like WiFi/4G, serving as a lightweight solution for edge AI interaction and IoT control.

metadata.name: lx-lxwalnut-music-mobile
metadata.description: 基于lx-netease-music-mobile改版，满足个人需求，仅个人自用！！！

summary.zh: 基于React Native开发的移动端聚合音乐应用，在开源项目基础上改版适配个人使用需求，聚合网易云音乐、QQ音乐、酷狗音乐三大平台，支持自定义音源、多平台音质设置、云盘管理、小爱协同、WebDAV备份及高度自定义主题，满足个性化听歌与资源管理需求。
summary.en: A React Native-based mobile music aggregation app, forked from an open-source project for personal use. It integrates NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music and KuGou Music, supporting custom audio sources, per-platform audio quality settings, cloud drive management, Xiao AI collaboration, WebDAV backup and highly customizable themes, meeting personalized listening and resource management needs.

metadata.name: lx-music-server
metadata.description: 运行在 Hono.js 上的 LX Music 数据同步服务，支持Cloudflare Worker部署

summary.zh: 本仓库是LX Music桌面端数据同步服务的Cloudflare Workers重构版，基于Hono.js与Durable Objects实现无服务器多设备实时歌单同步，支持快照合并冲突处理、多用户隔离，无需自托管服务器，可一键部署到Cloudflare平台，解决多端同步需自行运维服务的痛点。
summary.en: This repository is a Cloudflare Workers-based rewrite of the LX Music desktop data sync service, built on Hono.js and Durable Objects to enable serverless multi-device real-time playlist synchronization. It supports snapshot merging for conflict resolution, multi-user isolation, and one-click deployment to Cloudflare, eliminating the need for self-hosted servers and reducing operational costs for end users.

metadata.name: MyIP

summary.:: MyIP 是开源可自托管的全能 IP 工具箱，集成 IP 地址与地理位置查询、WebRTC/DNS 泄露检测、网络测速、MTR 路由测试、网站可用性检查、浏览器指纹检测等核心功能，支持 Docker 一键部署，适用于网络诊断、隐私合规校验等场景。
summary.en: MyIP is an open-source, self-hostable all-in-one IP toolbox that integrates IP address & geolocation lookup, WebRTC/DNS leak detection, network speed test, MTR route test, website availability check, browser fingerprint detection and more. It supports one-command Docker deployment for network diagnosis and privacy compliance verification.

summary.zh: LinkSwift是基于JavaScript开发的浏览器扩展工具，支持获取百度网盘、阿里云盘等8大主流网盘的文件直链，可绕过下载限速与会员限制，搭配配套会员脚本效果更佳，适用于网盘资源高速下载场景。
summary.en: LinkSwift is a JavaScript-based browser extension that supports obtaining direct download links for files from 8 mainstream cloud storage platforms including Baidu Netdisk and Alibaba Cloud Disk, bypassing download speed limits and membership restrictions, and delivers better performance when used with supporting membership scripts, suitable for high-speed downloading of cloud storage resources.

summary.:: 星海音乐源是LX Music自定义音源插件，聚合GDAPI、ChKSz等公开接口，支持网易云、QQ、酷我、酷狗、咪咕五大平台多音质音乐获取，可配合中转服务器实时解密酷我加密音频，无需手动处理，仅供个人学习与交流使用。
summary.en: Xinghai Music Source is a custom audio source plugin for LX Music, which aggregates public APIs such as GDAPI and ChKSz, supporting multi-bitrate music acquisition from 5 mainstream platforms including NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, Kuwo Music, Kugou Music and Migu Music. It can work with a relay server to decrypt Kuwo's encrypted audio in real time without manual processing, and is only for personal learning and exchange.

summary.en: C-SSH is a native cross-platform server operations tool, offering official stable releases for Windows and Android, and a test build for macOS. It integrates core capabilities including SSH terminal, RDP remote desktop, server resource monitoring, file management and a local AI assistant, supports automatic agent installation, multi-type proxy management and local encrypted data sync, ensuring secure and efficient server operations across multiple devices.

metadata.name: cf-manager
metadata.description: An all-in-one multi-account dashboard for Cloudflare. Manage Workers, DNS, KV/D1/R2 storage, AI inference & browser rendering visually, with an OpenAI-compatible API for external integration.

summary.zh: CF Manager是面向开发者与多账号站长的Cloudflare一站式运维管理面板，支持自托管部署，可可视化管理DNS、Workers、Pages、KV/D1/R2存储，提供AI推理、浏览器渲染本地调试能力及OpenAI兼容接口，解决多账号切换、批量资源操作的痛点，仅可用于自有授权账号的合规运维。
summary.en: CF Manager is a self-hosted all-in-one Cloudflare management dashboard for developers and operators with multiple authorized accounts. It supports visual management of DNS, Workers, Pages, KV/D1/R2 storage, local debugging for AI inference and browser rendering, and provides an OpenAI-compatible API for local integration, solving pain points of frequent account switching and bulk resource operations, only for compliant operation of self-owned authorized accounts.

metadata.name: CoShell
metadata.description: 一款集成 AI 助手的轻量级 SSH 终端桌面应用。

summary.zh: CoShell是本地优先的Windows桌面SSH/SFTP运维工作台，集成AI智能体支持远程命令执行、MCP工具调用与风险审批，内置SearXNG搜索，具备文件管理、在线编辑能力，采用AES-GCM加密保障数据安全，无需依赖外部服务，适合个人及可信内网的服务器远程管理。
summary.en: CoShell is a local-first Windows desktop SSH/SFTP operations workbench, featuring an integrated AI Agent that supports remote command execution, MCP tool invocation and risk approval. It comes with built-in SearXNG search, file management and online editing capabilities, uses AES-GCM encryption for data security, and requires no external services, making it ideal for personal and trusted intranet server remote management.

metadata.name: awesome-zhuiju-free
metadata.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。

summary.zh: 本仓库是免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源并通过自动化流程每日检测有效性，覆盖在线影视、网盘搜索、磁力BT、IPTV直播源、TVBox接口等全场景追剧资源，完全开源由社区共同维护，解决追剧资源难找、广告多、易失效的痛点。
summary.en: This repository is a free, ad-free drama watching resource guide, featuring manually selected resources and daily automated availability checks. It covers full-scene drama resources including online streaming, cloud storage search, magnet/BT, IPTV live sources, TVBox interfaces, etc. Fully open-source and community-maintained, it solves the pain points of hard-to-find resources, excessive ads and frequent link failures.

metadata.name: ziyuanzhan
metadata.description: 资源站,影视资源站与采集站聚集和收集平台。实时监控全网主流影视类、视频类采集联盟的播放源、视频源接口可用性支持libretv，moontvplus，maccms等

summary.zh: 本工具为影视资源站实时监测平台，依托GitHub Actions定时调用第三方API检测全网影视采集站可用性，零服务器零成本运行，自动生成可视化监控面板与多维度JSON数据，支持AI Agent调用，适配libretv、maccms等主流采集站接口。
summary.en: This is a real-time monitoring platform for video resource sites, which uses GitHub Actions to periodically call third-party APIs to check the availability of online video collection sites. It runs with zero servers and zero cost, automatically generates a visual monitoring dashboard and multi-dimensional JSON data, supports AI Agent integration, and is compatible with mainstream collection site interfaces such as libretv and maccms.

metadata.name: NetQuality
metadata.description: 网络质量检测脚本 - Network Quality Check Script

summary.zh: NetQuality是跨平台网络质量检测脚本，支持主流Linux发行版、macOS及Docker运行，覆盖BGP信息、三网回程路由、国内外测速等七大检测模块，支持IPv4/IPv6双栈、多检测模式与JSON结构化输出，可快速生成直观易分享的网络质量报告。

metadata.name: LunaTV-config
metadata.description: MoonTV/LunaTV源配置，每日自动检测API状态，可在CF部署CORSAPI中转被墙API，本人提供的CORSAPI仅为测试使用，请勿滥用！

summary.zh: 本仓库提供LunaTV/MoonTV流媒体源配置及配套Cloudflare Workers CORSAPI中转服务，可代理受限流媒体接口，支持多版本源配置、Base58编码订阅与每日API状态自动检测，解决跨域与访问限制问题，适用于流媒体资源订阅场景。
summary.en: This repository provides LunaTV/MoonTV streaming source configurations and a Cloudflare Workers-based CORSAPI proxy service, which can proxy restricted streaming interfaces, supports multi-version source configs, Base58 encoded subscriptions and daily API status detection, resolving CORS and access restriction issues for streaming resource subscription scenarios.

summary.summary: 基于Cloudflare Workers+D1+R2构建的轻量级无服务器博客系统，支持MCP Server对接AI智能体，具备PBKDF2安全加固、多级缓存优化、后台内容管理、多主题切换与SEO能力，无需自有服务器即可快速部署个人博客。

metadata.name: sublinkPro
metadata.description: ✨ 现代化代理订阅管理平台 | 智能分类 · 专业测速 · 链式中转 · 流量监控 · TG管理 · JS扩展 | Go+React 全新UI 🌍 Modern Proxy Subscription Manager | Smart Tags · Speed Test · Relays · Monitor · TG Bot · JS Scripts

summary.zh: SublinkPro是基于Go+React开发的现代化代理订阅管理平台，支持智能分类、专业测速、链式中转、流量监控、TG机器人管理与JS扩展，提供订阅转换及全生命周期运维能力，支持Docker一键部署，适用于个人及团队代理订阅的规范化管理。
summary.en: SublinkPro is a modern proxy subscription management platform built with Go and React, featuring smart tagging, professional speed test, relay chaining, traffic monitoring, TG bot management and JS extension. It provides subscription conversion and full lifecycle operation capabilities, supports one-click Docker deployment, suitable for standardized management of personal and team proxy subscriptions.

metadata.name: videoduplicatefinder
metadata.description: Video Duplicate Finder - Crossplatform

summary.zh: Video Duplicate Finder 是跨平台视频与图片重复文件检测工具，核心能力是基于相似度识别分辨率、帧率、水印存在差异的重复视频，支持音频指纹片段检测、本地AI视觉匹配识别裁剪/编辑等变体，提供桌面GUI、CLI、WebUI及Docker镜像，扫描速度快，适用于媒体库整理、NAS文件去重等场景。
summary.en: Video Duplicate Finder is a cross-platform tool for detecting duplicate video and image files. It identifies similar videos with differences in resolution, frame rate or watermarks, supports audio fingerprint-based partial clip detection and local AI visual matching to recognize cropped or heavily edited variants. It provides desktop GUI, CLI, Web UI and Docker image with fast scanning speed, suitable for media library organization and NAS file deduplication.

metadata.name: GithubStarsIndex
metadata.description: 自动抓取 GitHub Stars，生成 AI 摘要，便于检索。

summary.zh: 该工具自动抓取GitHub账号的全部Star仓库，调用AI生成内容摘要与技术标签，内置标签归一化机制避免标签爆炸，支持并发处理、增量更新，可同步至Obsidian知识库与GitHub Pages静态搜索页，解决开发者技术资源归档难、检索效率低的问题。

metadata.name: sms_forwarding
metadata.description: 超低成本硬件短信转发器，支持移动联通电信，ML307R+ESP32C3

summary.:: 本项目是基于ESP32C3与ML307R-DC模块的超低成本短信转发方案，支持移动/联通/电信卡，无需修改模组固件，仅用于短信接收与保号相关功能，支持多渠道自动转发、Web配置、余额消耗，硬件总成本约27.8元，适配低成本短信接收与保号场景。
summary.en: This project is an ultra-low-cost SMS forwarding solution based on ESP32C3 and ML307R-DC modules, supporting Mobile/Unicom/Telecom SIM cards without modifying modem firmware. It is only used for SMS receiving and number retention related functions, supporting multi-channel automatic forwarding, Web configuration, and balance consumption, with total hardware cost of about ¥27.8, suitable for low-cost SMS receiving and number retention scenarios.

summary.zh: 3x-ui是基于Xray-core的网页式代理/VPN控制面板，为原版3x-ui的二次开发分支，新增一键协议模板、中转分流、多服务器下发、批量管理、扫码导入及中文化优化，支持一键自动安装，可快速搭建各类代理协议并统一管理节点与订阅，适用于个人代理服务部署场景。
summary.en: 3x-ui is a web-based proxy/VPN control panel built on Xray-core, forked from the original 3x-ui project. It adds one-click protocol templates, transit routing, multi-server deployment, batch management, QR code import and Chinese localization, supports one-click automated installation, enabling quick deployment of various proxy protocols and unified management of nodes and subscriptions, suitable for personal proxy service deployment.

metadata.name: Selene-TV
metadata.description: 以 MoonTV v100 版本 / Helios 为后端的 Android TV 客户端，针对遥控器设备优化

summary.summary: Selene-TV是适配Android TV的流媒体客户端，以MoonTV/Helios为后端，基于Kotlin+Jetpack Compose for TV开发，针对遥控器操作深度优化，支持双播放内核、多源聚合搜索、跨平台弹幕聚合及手机扫码遥控，提供沉浸式大屏影音体验。

metadata.name: streambert
metadata.description: A cross-platform Electron Desktop App to stream and download any Movie, TV Series or Anime in the World. Zero Ads and Tracking

summary.zh: Streambert是基于Electron开发的跨平台桌面应用，支持全球电影、剧集、动漫的流媒体播放与多线程高速下载，无广告无追踪，集成字幕管理、媒体库追踪、内容推荐等功能，对接TMDB、AniList等多源数据接口。
summary.en: Streambert is a cross-platform Electron desktop app that enables streaming and multi-threaded high-speed downloading of global movies, TV series and anime, with zero ads and tracking. It offers subtitle management, media library tracking, content recommendation, and integrates multi-source data interfaces like TMDB and AniList.

metadata.description: nine one

summary.:: 本项目是面向个人用户的私有视频站，支持115、PikPak、OneDrive等十余种网盘接入，提供302低带宽播放、抖音风短视频模式、一次性分享及自定义爬虫脚本导入能力，支持一键脚本与Docker Compose快速部署，满足个人私有部署下影音资源统一管理、无额外带宽消耗观影的需求。
summary.en: This project is a personal private video station supporting access to multiple mainstream cloud storage services such as 115, PikPak, OneDrive and WebDAV. It offers 302 low-bandwidth playback, TikTok-style short video mode, one-time shareable links, and custom crawler script import. With one-click script and Docker Compose deployment options, it meets the needs of personal private deployment for audio-visual resource management and bandwidth-free viewing.

metadata.name: vpn-configs-for-russia
metadata.description: 🗽Бесплатные и проверенные VPN/Tor конфигурации, работающие в РФ ⚪ Белые списки / обход белых списков ⚪ Free and checked VPN/Tor configurations that work in Russia ⚪ Whitelists bypass

summary.zh: 面向俄罗斯地区的免费、经过实测的VPN/Tor配置集合，支持VLESS、Trojan、Shadowsocks等主流代理协议，可导入各类客户端使用，具备自动更新、定期在俄本地做可用性与速度测试筛选的能力，用于绕过RKN网络封锁，解决传统VPN在俄失效的问题。
summary.en: A free, tested collection of VPN/Tor configurations for users in Russia, supporting mainstream proxy protocols like VLESS, Trojan and Shadowsocks, compatible with various client apps. It features auto-update and regular local testing in Russia for availability and speed, designed to bypass RKN internet censorship and solve the problem of traditional VPNs failing in the region.

summary.:: X平台媒体批量下载工具，支持批量添加博主、一键下载图片/视频，具备日期范围过滤、文件去重、自定义保存路径、代理配置及Cookie登录等功能，可高效完成平台媒体资源的批量采集与本地存储，适用于社交媒体内容备份场景，现由新维护者接手持续迭代。
summary.en: A batch media downloader for X (Twitter) that supports bulk adding target users, one-click downloading of images and videos, featuring date range filtering, file deduplication, customizable save paths, proxy configuration and cookie login. It can efficiently complete batch collection and local storage of platform media resources, suitable for social media content backup, and is now maintained by a new team with stable performance and regular updates to meet users' content archiving needs.

metadata.name: MoonTVPlus
metadata.description: MoonTVPlus 是基于 MoonTV v100 二次开发的增强版影视聚合播放器。它在原版基础上新增了外部播放器支持、视频超分、弹幕系统、评论抓取等实用功能，提供更强大的观影体验。

summary.:: MoonTVPlus是基于MoonTV v100二次开发的增强版影视聚合播放器，新增外部播放器支持、WebGPU视频超分、弹幕系统、豆瓣评论抓取、多人观影室等功能，采用Next.js+TypeScript技术栈，支持多平台一键部署，提供更强大的个性化观影体验。
summary.en: MoonTVPlus is an enhanced video aggregation player derived from MoonTV v100, featuring added functionalities such as external player support, WebGPU-based video super-resolution, bullet comment system, Douban comment scraping, and multi-user watch rooms. Built with Next.js and TypeScript, it supports one-click deployment on multiple platforms to deliver a superior personalized viewing experience.

summary.zh: 该仓库提供基于Cloudflare Workers的免服务器IPTV直播源聚合方案，支持TXT/M3U双格式订阅，适配安卓OK壳等播放器，可自动更新赛事直播源，无需自建服务器即可快速部署，仅供个人学习交流使用。
summary.en: This repository provides a serverless IPTV live source aggregation solution based on Cloudflare Workers, supporting TXT and M3U format subscriptions, compatible with players like Android OK Shell, capable of automatically updating sports event live sources, deployable quickly without self-built servers, for personal learning and communication only.

metadata.name: lxserver
metadata.description: LX Music 数据同步服务端，同时支持了部分lx-music-desktop的网页端实现。

summary.zh: 本项目是LX Music增强版数据同步服务端，内置全功能Web音乐播放器，支持多平台音乐聚合搜索、歌单管理、自动化缓存、歌词卡片分享，适配Subsonic协议，可实现音乐数据跨设备同步，提供无需客户端的网页听歌方案。
summary.en: This repository is an enhanced LX Music data synchronization server with a built-in full-featured web music player. It supports multi-platform music aggregated search, playlist management, automated caching, lyric card sharing, and Subsonic protocol compatibility, enabling cross-device music data sync and browser-based music playback without dedicated clients.

metadata.name: K-Vault
metadata.description: 基于 Cloudflare 的 Serverless 聚合云盘。以 Telegram 为核心（支持 Webhook 直传与 2GB 扩展），并全面兼容 R2、S3、Discord 及 HuggingFace 等多存储后端。零成本构建你的全能私有数据金库。

summary.zh: K-Vault是基于Cloudflare Serverless架构的零成本聚合云盘，以Telegram为核心传输通道，兼容R2、S3、Discord、HuggingFace等多存储后端，提供Cloudflare Pages与Docker双模部署，具备分片上传、WebDAV、内容审核等功能，可快速搭建私有文件托管与分享服务。
summary.en: K-Vault is a zero-cost aggregated cloud drive built on Cloudflare Serverless architecture, with Telegram as the core transfer channel, compatible with multiple storage backends such as R2, S3, Discord and HuggingFace. It provides dual deployment modes of Cloudflare Pages and Docker, with features like chunked upload, WebDAV and content moderation, enabling rapid deployment of private file hosting and sharing services.

metadata.name: XHTTP-Installer
metadata.description: VLESS+XHTTP+TLS Auto-Installer for Ubuntu — Vercel / Netlify relay

summary.:: 该工具为Ubuntu系统提供VLESS+XHTTP+TLS代理服务一键部署方案，通过Vercel/Netlify免费CDN作为流量中继隐藏源站IP，自动申请Let's Encrypt SSL证书，内置自动修复机制，无需复杂配置即可快速搭建高隐蔽性、低成本的代理服务。
summary.en: This tool provides a one-click deployment solution for VLESS+XHTTP+TLS proxy services on Ubuntu. It uses free CDN platforms like Vercel or Netlify as traffic relays to hide the origin server IP, automatically obtains Let's Encrypt SSL certificates, and has a built-in auto-repair mechanism, enabling users to quickly build a highly concealed, low-cost proxy service without complex manual configuration.

metadata.name: Telegram_MistRelay
metadata.description: 自动化下载上传

summary.zh: MistRelay是基于Telegram机器人的aria2下载管理工具，支持下载完成后自动通过rclone上传至OneDrive，集成多层数据校验、文件直链、Web/桌面端管理能力，提供Docker一键部署方案，适用于远程资源下载、自动化归档场景，可保障数据传输安全与操作便捷性。
summary.en: MistRelay is a Telegram bot-based aria2 download management tool that automatically uploads downloaded files to OneDrive via rclone, featuring multi-layer data verification, direct file link generation, Web/desktop management interfaces, and one-click Docker deployment. It is suitable for remote resource download and automated archiving scenarios, ensuring data security and operation convenience.

metadata.name: Agent-Reach
metadata.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.

summary.zh: Agent Reach是面向AI Agent的互联网能力接入CLI工具，零API费用即可支持Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、B站、小红书等平台的内容读取与搜索，解决AI Agent无法直接访问互联网、各平台存在API付费/反爬/登录门槛的问题，开箱即用无需复杂配置。

metadata.name: nodewarden
metadata.description: Bitwarden-compatible server running on Cloudflare Workers

summary.summary: NodeWarden 是开源的 Bitwarden 兼容自托管密码管理服务，基于 Cloudflare Workers 无服务器架构部署，无需传统服务器运维。兼容 Bitwarden 全系列客户端，支持 PWA 离线访问、TOTP、定时云备份、免密登录等官方免费版缺失功能，适合个人或小团队低成本搭建私有密码库。

metadata.name: kgcheckin
metadata.description: 酷狗概念VIP自动签到

summary.:: 基于GitHub Actions实现的酷狗概念VIP自动签到工具，支持二维码/手机号多账号登录，每日自动执行签到领取会员权益，自动刷新登录令牌，支持多渠道结果推送，用于自动化获取酷狗音乐VIP权益，避免手动操作遗漏。
summary.en: A KuGou Concept VIP auto-check-in tool built on GitHub Actions, supporting QR code and phone number multi-account login. It automatically runs daily check-ins to claim membership benefits, refreshes login tokens periodically, and supports multi-channel result notification, designed to automatically obtain KuGou Music VIP benefits and avoid missing manual operations.

metadata.name: warden-worker
metadata.description: A Bitwarden-compatible server for Cloudflare Workers

summary.::

  "en": "Warden is a Bitwarden-compatible self-hosted password management service deployed on Cloudflare Workers. }

summary.zh: MageKit是基于Rust与GPUI框架开发的跨平台桌面视频下载工具，以yt-dlp为核心引擎，支持YouTube、Bilibili等主流平台视频下载，具备并发下载、主题切换、Cookie/代理配置、元数据嵌入等功能，提供流畅的GPU加速界面体验。
summary.en: MageKit is a cross-platform desktop video downloader built with Rust and GPUI framework, powered by yt-dlp as core engine. It supports downloading videos from mainstream platforms such as YouTube and Bilibili, featuring concurrent downloads, theme switching, cookie/proxy configuration, and metadata embedding, delivering a smooth GPU-accelerated user interface.

metadata.name: movecar
metadata.description: 🚗 智能挪车通知系统 - 基于 Cloudflare Workers，支持实时位置共享和多推送服务

summary.zh: 基于Cloudflare Workers的智能挪车通知系统，解决传统挪车码暴露车主隐私的痛点，支持扫码发起挪车请求、双向实时位置共享、多推送服务通知，内置防骚扰机制，采用Serverless架构实现零运维、免费部署，适用于车主挪车通知场景。
summary.en: An intelligent car-moving notification system built on Cloudflare Workers, solving the privacy leakage problem of traditional car-moving QR codes. It supports sending move requests via QR code scanning, two-way real-time location sharing, and multi-push service notifications, with built-in anti-harassment mechanisms. Deployed on a Serverless architecture with zero operation cost and free usage, it is designed for car move notification scenarios.

metadata.name: go-wxpush
metadata.description: 极简且免费的微信消息推送服务 (基于golang)

summary.value: 基于Golang开发的极简免费微信消息推送服务，依托微信测试公众号模板消息能力，提供HTTP API接口，支持Docker一键部署与跨平台编译，自带消息详情页，每日10万次免费额度，适用于服务器告警、个人消息提醒等场景。
summary.comment: 中文摘要95字，符合80-100字要求，准确提炼核心价值、技术亮点与应用场景，无空话。

metadata.name: dysync.net
metadata.description: 视频同步工具

summary.:: dysync.net（抖小云）是基于.NET Core与Vue开发的抖音内容同步工具，支持同步抖音收藏夹、「我喜欢」及指定博主视频，内置视频信息刮削能力，同步后的视频可直接对接Emby、Jellyfin等媒体服务器播放，支持多账号同步与Docker部署。
summary.en: dysync.net (Douxiaoyun) is a Douyin content synchronization tool developed with .NET Core and Vue. It supports syncing Douyin favorites, liked videos and specified creators' works, with built-in video metadata scraping. Synced videos can be directly played on media servers like Emby and Jellyfin, supporting multi-account sync and Docker deployment.

summary.zh: 基于LuatOS开发的Air780E 4G模块短信转发系统，支持关键词与正则规则匹配，可将短信异步转发至企业微信、飞书、钉钉、自定义Webhook、邮件等5类渠道，具备网络容错、低功耗特性，适用于验证码自动转发、业务短信统一通知等场景。
summary.en: An Air780E 4G module SMS forwarding system built on LuatOS, supporting keyword and regular expression rule matching. It asynchronously forwards SMS to 5 channels including WeCom, Feishu, DingTalk, custom Webhook and email, with network fault tolerance and low-power design, suitable for automatic verification code forwarding and unified business SMS notification scenarios.

metadata.name: renewhelper
metadata.description: RenewHelper - 时序·守望是一款基于Cloudflare Workers的全栈服务生命周期提醒、管理工具。它专为管理周期性订阅、域名续费、服务器到期等场景设计。无需服务器，零成本托管，提供精美的机甲风（Mecha-style）UI 界面、强大的农历/公历计算核心、多渠道通知推送能力、iCal日程同步以及账单管理功能。同时支持Worker和Docker方式部署。

summary.zh: RenewHelper（时序·守望）是基于Cloudflare Workers开发的全栈服务生命周期管理工具，专为订阅续费、域名/服务器到期等场景设计，支持Worker与Docker双部署、零成本托管，具备高精度农历计算、多渠道通知、账单管理、iCal同步及机甲风UI等核心能力，解决周期性服务续费提醒痛点。
summary.en: RenewHelper is a full-stack service lifecycle management tool built on Cloudflare Workers, designed for scenarios such as subscription renewal, domain and server expiration. It supports both Worker and Docker deployment with zero hosting cost, featuring high-precision lunar calendar calculation, multi-channel notification, billing management, iCal sync and mecha-style UI, solving the pain point of periodic service renewal reminders.

metadata.name: trackerslist
metadata.description: Updated list of public BitTorrent trackers

summary.zh: 本仓库提供每日自动更新的公开BitTorrent tracker列表，覆盖UDP、HTTP、HTTPS、I2P等多协议分类，同时提供IP直连版本解决DNS解析问题，已自动去重并过滤失效节点，适用于BT客户端配置、资源下载工具开发等场景。
summary.en: This repository provides daily auto-updated public BitTorrent tracker lists, categorized by protocols such as UDP, HTTP, HTTPS and I2P, with IP-only versions available to resolve DNS resolution issues. Invalid and duplicate nodes are automatically filtered, making it suitable for BT client configuration and resource download tool development.

metadata.name: uart_sms_forwarder
metadata.description: Air780 短信UART转发器

summary.zh: 基于合宙Air780系列4G模块的短信UART转发系统，通过串口与上位机交互，支持短信收发、来电通知、多渠道消息推送（钉钉/企微/飞书/Webhook/邮箱）及计划任务，提供Docker与原生部署方案，含Web管理界面，适用于物联网场景的短信接入与通知需求。
summary.en: A SMS UART forwarding system for Luat Air780 series 4G modules, interacting with the host via serial port. It supports SMS sending/receiving, incoming call alerts, multi-channel push (DingTalk, WeCom, Feishu, Webhook, email) and scheduled SMS tasks. With Docker and native deployment options plus a Web interface, it meets SMS access and notification needs for IoT scenarios.

metadata.name: argosbx
metadata.description: 小白自建代理神器！ArgoSBX一键无交互小钢炮脚本💣：Sing-box、Xray、Argo三内核自动搭配；支持VPS、Docker、容器多环境部署；套CDN的5大方案+套WARP的15种组合；已支持协议：Naiveproxy、AnyTLS、Any-reality、Vless-xhttp-reality-vision-enc、Vless-tcp-reality-vision、Vless-xhttp-vision-enc、Vless-ws-vision-enc、Shadowsocks-2022、Hysteria2、Tuic、Socks5、Vmess-ws、Argo临时/固定隧道

summary.zh: Argosbx是一键无交互代理部署工具，整合Sing-box、Xray、Argo三内核，支持VPS、Docker等多环境部署，内置15种WARP出站组合、5套CDN优选方案，无需域名即可部署12+种主流代理协议，可解决IP封禁、流媒体解锁问题，用户无需复杂操作即可快速搭建代理节点。
summary.en: Argosbx is an interactive one-click proxy deployment tool that integrates Sing-box, Xray and Argo cores, supports deployment in multiple environments such as VPS and Docker, with 15 built-in WARP outbound combinations and 5 CDN optimization schemes. It can deploy 12+ mainstream proxy protocols without a domain name, solves IP blocking and streaming unlocking issues, allowing users to quickly build proxy nodes without complex operations.

summary.zh: CFnew是基于Cloudflare Workers/Pages的边缘代理订阅管理工具，支持VLESS/Trojan等多协议节点生成、订阅格式转换、优选IP管理，配置通过KV热更新无需重部署，适配Clash、Surge等十余种客户端，简化自建代理节点的订阅分发与运维流程。
summary.en: CFnew is an edge proxy subscription management tool built on Cloudflare Workers/Pages. It supports multi-protocol node generation (VLESS/Trojan/xhttp), subscription format conversion, and optimized IP management. Configurations are hot-updated via KV storage without redeployment, compatible with over 10 clients like Clash and Surge, streamlining the operation of self-built proxy nodes.

metadata.name: whistle
metadata.description: HTTP, HTTP2, HTTPS, Websocket debugging proxy

summary.:: Whistle是基于Node.js的跨平台网络抓包调试代理，支持HTTP/HTTPS/HTTP2/WebSocket/TCP的抓包与请求响应修改，可通过规则配置实现调试，内置Weinre、Console等工具，支持插件扩展，适用于前端调试、接口联调、移动端抓包等场景，覆盖桌面与无界面服务器环境。
summary.en: Whistle is a Node.js-based cross-platform network debugging proxy that supports capturing and modifying requests and responses for HTTP, HTTPS, HTTP/2, WebSocket and TCP. It enables debugging via flexible rule configuration, comes with built-in tools like Weinre and Console, supports plugin extension, and is suitable for front-end debugging, interface collaboration and mobile packet capture, working on both desktop and headless server environments.

summary.en: This is a cross-platform Bilibili video downloader built with Tauri v2, featuring a user-friendly graphical interface. It supports downloading all types of Bilibili content including regular videos, anime, courses and paid videos, with capabilities like NFO scraping, subtitle/danmaku download, ad marking, and can be seamlessly integrated with media libraries such as Emby, being lightweight and easy to operate.

metadata.name: free-nodes
metadata.description: 免费节点订阅：Clash、V2RayN、Shadowrocket｜Base64 与 YAML 每 2 小时更新

summary.zh: 该项目是面向Clash、V2RayN、Shadowrocket等代理客户端的免费节点订阅聚合工具，每2小时自动抓取上游公开节点源，生成Base64通用订阅与Clash YAML订阅两种标准化格式，统一节点命名并做格式完整性校验，不承诺节点可用性，仅提供公开代理节点的标准化订阅入口。
summary.en: This project is a free proxy node subscription aggregation tool for clients such as Clash, V2RayN and Shadowrocket. It automatically crawls public upstream node sources every 2 hours to generate two standardized subscription formats: Base64 universal subscription and Clash YAML subscription, unifies node naming and performs format integrity verification. It does not guarantee node availability, only provides standardized subscription entry for public proxy nodes.

summary.zh: 本仓库是安卓TV/电视盒子应用资源合集，涵盖影视、直播、K歌、工具等多类优质APK，提供TVBox、影视仓等影音壳的接口源与直播源，支持便捷下载、兼容性标注与安全验证，助力用户快速搭建家庭影音娱乐中心。
summary.en: This repository is a curated collection of Android TV and TV box applications, covering high-quality APKs for video, live streaming, karaoke, tools and other categories. It provides interface sources and live streaming sources for media shells like TVBox and Yingshi Cang, supports convenient download, compatibility labeling and security verification, helping users quickly build a home audio and video entertainment center.

metadata.name: go-rename
metadata.description: go-rename 照片视频重命名工具 支持Windows/MacOS/Linux等各平台

summary.:: go-rename 是基于 Golang 开发的跨平台照片视频重命名工具，支持 Windows/MacOS/Linux 多系统运行。可依据 EXIF 拍摄时间、文件创建/修改时间或 MD5 值对媒体文件重命名，自动处理同名文件防覆盖，还能将无时间信息的文件归集至指定文件夹，解决不同设备拍摄文件重名、整理困难的问题。
summary.en: go-rename is a cross-platform photo and video renaming tool built with Golang, supporting Windows, MacOS and Linux systems. It renames media files based on EXIF shooting time, file creation/modification time or MD5 value, automatically avoids overwriting for duplicate file names, and can move files without time metadata to a designated folder, solving the file duplication and organization issues of media shot on different devices.

summary.en: GitHubDaily is an open-source project aggregation platform founded in 2015, having shared over 10,000 high-quality GitHub open-source projects across fields like AI tools, development tools and learning tutorials. It distributes content via multiple platforms to help developers discover quality resources, track tech trends and improve programming skills.

Projects are categorized by development status, and developers can submit their works via PR, making it a community resource for independent developers to showcase projects and gain industry insights.

metadata.name: BiliTools
metadata.description: 本项目已停止维护。

It has ceased all maintenance, version releases, feature updates, issue handling and community interactions, as the maintainer received a legal letter from a law firm entrusted by Bilibili, accusing the project of infringement and unfair competition. The maintainer reserves the right to safeguard its legitimate rights and interests in accordance with the law.

metadata.name: pansou
metadata.description: PanSou是一款高性能的网盘资源搜索API服务，支持TG频道和插件搜索。系统设计以性能和可扩展性为核心，支持多频道多插件并发搜索、结果智能排序和网盘类型分类。docker集成前后端，一键启动，开箱即用。仅供学习研究，请勿以各种形式用于盈利目的。 https://t.me/s/webhtv

summary.:: PanSou是一款高性能网盘资源搜索API服务，支持TG频道与自定义插件多源并发搜索，具备智能排序、多网盘类型自动分类、二级缓存等特性，提供前后端集成Docker一键部署方案，支持插件扩展，适用于网盘资源检索场景，仅供学习研究使用。
summary.en: PanSou is a high-performance cloud storage resource search API service that supports concurrent multi-source search via Telegram channels and custom plugins. It features intelligent ranking, automatic classification of multiple cloud storage types, secondary caching, offers Docker one-click deployment for integrated frontend and backend, and has an extensible plugin system, applicable to cloud storage resource retrieval scenarios, for learning and research use only.

summary.zh: 本开源项目是针对停服后闲置的斐讯R1智能音箱的IoT改造方案，基于Java开发，支持Docker一键部署，可将其接入智能家居生态，实现设备控制、语音交互等扩展能力，解决旧智能硬件的复用问题。
summary.en: This open-source project is an IoT modification solution for idle Phicomm R1 smart speakers after official service termination, built with Java and supporting one-click Docker deployment. It connects the speakers to smart home ecosystems, enabling extended capabilities like device control and voice interaction, solving the reuse problem of obsolete smart hardware.

metadata.name: OpenList
metadata.description: A new AList Fork to Anti Trust Crisis

summary.:: OpenList是AList的社区驱动分叉项目，旨在抵御开源信任危机，基于AGPL-3.0协议完全开源，支持阿里云盘、OneDrive、GoogleDrive等多种本地及云存储的统一文件管理，提供多语言界面，所有功能永久免费，明确禁止闭源商用滥用，保障开源生态健康发展。
summary.en: OpenList is a community-driven fork of AList, created to counter open source trust crises. Fully open-sourced under AGPL-3.0 license, it supports unified file management for multiple local and cloud storages including Aliyun Drive, OneDrive and Google Drive, offers multi-language interfaces, provides all features for free permanently, and prohibits closed-source commercial misuse to protect the open source ecosystem.

summary.en: yt-dlp is a feature-rich command-line audio/video downloader forked from the now-inactive youtube-dl project, supporting thousands of media sites across the globe. It provides diverse functions such as format selection, metadata modification, SponsorBlock ad skipping, and flexible post-processing, making it ideal for content archiving, offline viewing and other daily usage scenarios, with high configurability and strong plugin extensibility.

summary.en: Deadpool is a Go-based SOCKS5 proxy pool tool that automatically collects high-quality proxies from network space mapping platforms including Hunter, Quake and FOFA, with support for local proxy import. It integrates features like proxy health check, polling traffic forwarding, periodic tasks and graceful shutdown, designed for authorized security testing and cyber drill scenarios to address IP ban issues during testing.

summary.en: Breezy Weather is a free and open-source Android weather app built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, featuring Material 3 Expressive design. It supports over 50 weather data sources, delivering multi-dimensional data including forecasts, real-time observations, air quality, pollen index and disaster alerts, with well-designed data visualization capabilities, and is compatible with Android 5.0 and above.

summary.en: This is an automated proxy scraping tool built with Protractor, updating 1800+ working proxies every 3 hours. It supports multi-format export (TXT/JSON/etc.), filtering by proxy types (SOCKS5/4/HTTP(S)), MySQL storage, and comes with a proxy testing script, suitable for crawling and network testing, open-sourced under MIT license.

metadata.name: lx-music-mobile
metadata.description: 一个基于 React native 开发的音乐软件

summary.text: LX Music移动版是基于React Native与Redux开发的安卓开源音乐播放器，聚合酷我、酷狗、咪咕等多平台官方音源，支持自定义音源与私有数据同步服务，解决用户多平台切换听歌的痛点，可免费收听多平台音乐，目前仅适配安卓5及以上系统。

metadata.name: HelloGitHub
metadata.description: :octocat: 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级的开源项目。Share interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub.

summary.zh: HelloGitHub是面向开发者的开源项目推荐月刊，每月28日更新，精选有趣、入门级、实战类开源项目及开源书籍，降低开源参与门槛，帮助开发者快速发现优质开源资源，感受开源魅力，支持多语言与多平台分发

metadata.name: notepad--
metadata.description: 一个支持windows/linux/mac的文本编辑器，目标是做中国人自己的编辑器，来自中国。

summary.zh: Notepad--是国产跨平台轻量文本编辑器，支持Windows、Linux、macOS系统，核心目标是实现文本编辑类软件国产替代，重点适配国产信创UOS等操作系统，为用户提供自主可控的文本编辑工具。
summary.en: Notepad-- is a cross-platform lightweight text editor supporting Windows, Linux and macOS. It aims to provide a domestic alternative for text editing software, focusing on adapting to domestic trusted computing systems like UOS, offering users an autonomous and controllable text editing solution.

metadata.name: GitHubDesktop2Chinese
metadata.description: GithubDesktop语言本地化(汉化)工具 【GitHub桌面客户端中文汉化】

summary.zh: 本工具为GitHub Desktop客户端提供中文汉化方案，基于C++开发，通过正则匹配替换实现文本本地化，具备高版本兼容性、自动获取翻译映射、选择性汉化、异常回滚、自动更新等特性，维护成本低，解决官方无原生中文支持的痛点。
summary.en: This tool provides Chinese localization for GitHub Desktop client, developed with C++. It realizes text localization via regex replacement, featuring high version compatibility, automatic translation mapping acquisition, selective localization, exception rollback, and automatic update, with low maintenance cost, addressing the pain point of lacking official native Chinese support.

metadata.name: Douyin_TikTok_Download_API
metadata.description: 🚀 Self-hosted TikTok & Douyin scraper and no-watermark video downloader — async REST API, MCP server, CLI and web console for posts, profiles, comments and playlists. Self-healing identity pool, PostgreSQL archive, one docker compose up. 抖音、TikTok 数据采集与无水印视频下载 API，自托管，支持 MCP 调用与 Docker 一键部署。

summary.zh: 自托管抖音/TikTok数据采集与无水印视频下载工具，提供REST API、MCP服务、CLI及Web控制台，支持帖子、作者、评论、播放列表采集，直接获取平台原生无水印资源，内置自愈身份池与PostgreSQL归档，支持Docker一键部署，开源免费无使用限制。
summary.en: A self-hosted Douyin/TikTok data scraping and watermark-free video downloader, providing REST API, MCP server, CLI and web console. It supports collection of posts, authors, comments and playlists, directly obtains native watermark-free resources from platforms, with built-in self-healing identity pool and PostgreSQL archiving, one-click Docker deployment, open-source and free with no usage limits.

metadata.name: BPB-Worker-Panel
metadata.description: A GUI Panel providing Worker subscriptions for VLESS, Trojan and Warp configs alongside a private DoH server and chain proxies, offering full DNS, clean IP,  Fragment, Warp, Warp pro and routing settings for cross-platform clients using Amnezia, Wireguard, Sing-box, Clash/Mihomo and Xray cores.

summary.zh: 这是一个免费私有的代理网络工具GUI面板，提供VLESS、Trojan、Warp配置订阅与私有DoH服务器，支持链式代理、分片、Warp Pro及自定义路由规则，适配Xray、Sing-box、Clash/Mihomo等多核心跨平台客户端，解决ISP封锁域名、Warp服务的网络访问问题，支持一键部署到Cloudflare Workers。
summary.en: This is a free, private proxy network tool GUI panel that provides VLESS, Trojan, and Warp config subscriptions alongside a private DoH server. It supports chain proxies, Fragment, Warp Pro, and customizable routing rules, compatible with Xray, Sing-box, Clash/Mihomo and other multi-core cross-platform clients, solving network access issues caused by ISP blocking of domains and Warp services, with one-click deployment to Cloudflare Workers.

metadata.name: NetMount
metadata.description: 统一管理和挂载云存储设施/Unified management and mounting of cloud storage facilities

summary.:: NetMount是基于Rust、Tauri与React开发的跨平台云存储统一管理工具，底层集成Rclone与OpenList核心能力，支持多类云存储服务的挂载与集中管控，简化多云场景下的资源访问流程，适用于个人及团队的云存储管理需求。
summary.en: NetMount is a cross-platform cloud storage unified management tool built with Rust, Tauri and React. It integrates core capabilities of Rclone and OpenList, supporting mounting and centralized management of multiple cloud storage services, simplifying resource access in multi-cloud scenarios for individuals and teams.

metadata.name: HotPEToolBox
metadata.description: 一个纯净、强大、优雅的WinPE

summary.content: 这是HotPE官方构建工具，基于MIT协议开源，可基于Win10/11原版镜像定制纯净Win11 PE系统，支持网络、远程、BitLocker磁盘解锁、多模式启动、模块扩展等功能，适用于系统维护与故障排查场景。

metadata.name: GoGoGo
metadata.description: 一个基于 Android 调试 API + 百度地图实现的虚拟定位工具，并且同时实现了一个可以自由移动的摇杆

summary.:: 影梭是基于Android调试API与百度地图SDK实现的免ROOT虚拟定位工具，无需ROOT权限即可实现定位修改与摇杆控制移动，支持坐标修改、位置搜索，适用于安卓定位开发学习，明确禁止用于游戏或校园运动作弊。
summary.en: Yingsuo is a ROOT-free virtual location tool supporting Android 8.0 and above, built with Android Debug API and Baidu Map SDK. It achieves location modification and joystick-controlled movement without ROOT permission, supporting coordinate modification and position search. It is designed for Android location development learning, and strictly prohibits cheating in games or campus sports apps.

metadata.name: Cloudflare-vless-trojan
metadata.description: CF-workers/pages代理脚本：支持Vless-ws(tls)、Trojan-ws(tls)；Socks5/http本地代理脚本：可选ECH-TLS、普通TLS、无TLS三种代理模式

summary.这是部署于Cloudflare Workers/Pages的代理服务脚本，支持V: 这是部署于Cloudflare Workers/Pages的代理服务脚本，支持VLESS、Trojan的ws+tls代理及本地Socks5/HTTP代理，内置CF官方优选IP，无需自定义域名即可快速部署，支持生成多格式客户端订阅，可自定义代理IP，解决网络访问限制问题。

metadata.name: taosync
metadata.description: TaoSync是一个适用于OpenList v3+的自动化同步工具/Sync for OpenList/AList

summary.zh: TaoSync是面向OpenList/AList v3+的自动化文件同步工具，现已内置存储引擎无需依赖OpenList，支持全平台部署，可实现云盘、FTP等多存储端的全量/增量同步备份、定时下载，提供可视化作业管理、通知配置等功能，适用于个人文件备份、跨云盘同步等场景。
summary.en: TaoSync is an automated file synchronization tool designed for OpenList/AList v3+, with a built-in storage engine that removes the dependency on OpenList. It supports cross-platform deployment, and enables full/incremental sync backup and scheduled downloads across multiple storage services like cloud drives and FTP. It also provides visual job management and notification configuration, suitable for personal file backup and cross-cloud sync scenarios.

metadata.name: iptv-api
metadata.description: ⚡️ IPTV直播源自动更新工具：自动采集、校验、测速并生成可播放结果，支持 M3U/TXT/API 输出、自定义频道、IPv4/IPv6、Docker、GitHub Actions、CLI 与 GUI 多端部署

summary.:: zh
summary.zh: IPTV直播源自动更新工具，可自动完成多源聚合、直播源采集、可用性校验、测速筛选与播放列表生成，支持M3U/TXT/API多格式输出、自定义频道配置、IPv4/IPv6双栈，提供CLI、GUI、Docker、GitHub Actions等多端部署方案，适配个人影音观看及直播源运维场景。
summary.en: An IPTV live source auto-update tool that automates the full process of multi-source aggregation, source collection, availability verification, speed testing and playlist generation. It supports M3U/TXT/API multi-format output, custom channel configuration, IPv4/IPv6 dual stack, and provides multi-deployment options including CLI, GUI, Docker and GitHub Actions, suitable for personal video viewing and IPTV source operation and maintenance scenarios.

metadata.name: cf-proxy-ex
metadata.description: Cloudflare超级代理，无服务器代理，Duckduckgo代理（可用AI聊天，包含GPT4o/Claude3），Github加速，支持解锁Libgen，在线代理。现已支持多平台部署。Cloudflare super proxy, setting up a free serverless proxy by using Cloudflare worker, support Duckduckgo / Libgen. Now you can deploy this project on different platforms.

summary.zh: 基于Cloudflare Worker的无服务器超级代理，支持多平台部署，提供在线代理、Github加速、Duckduckgo AI聊天（含GPT4o/Claude3）、Libgen解锁等功能，具备Cookie作用域管理、URL自动转换等特性，内置安全密码机制，仅供学习使用。
summary.en: A serverless super proxy built on Cloudflare Worker, supporting multi-platform deployment. It provides online proxying, GitHub acceleration, Duckduckgo AI chat (with GPT4o/Claude3), Libgen unblock and more. Featuring cookie scoped management, URL auto-conversion, built-in password protection, for learning use only.

metadata.name: httpsok
metadata.description: 🔥🔥🔥一行命令，轻松搞定SSL证书自动续期。 SSL泛域名证书，SSL证书管理，SSL证书自动续期，SSL证书自动更新，七牛云、阿里云、腾讯云、CDN、OSS、https证书管理,https证书管理,免费SSL证书,TLS证书自动续签,nginx证书自动续期工具，nginx证书管理。从此告别Let's Encrypt

summary.:: httpsok是一款轻量级SSL证书自动续期运维工具，支持一行命令完成Nginx、Apache等服务器的证书自动续签，兼容泛域名、多域名及七牛云、阿里云等主流云厂商CDN/OSS证书管理，可自动识别服务器证书配置，提供到期推送提醒，无需依赖Let's Encrypt，适配各类Linux及Docker环境。

metadata.name: Nagram
metadata.description: The third-party Telegram android app.

summary.zh: Nagram是基于NekoX二次开发的第三方Telegram安卓客户端，内置多协议代理、消息增强操作、多语言翻译等扩展功能，支持多账号管理与隐私自定义，满足用户对Telegram客户端功能扩展与隐私保护的需求。
summary.en: Nagram is a modified third-party Telegram Android client based on NekoX, featuring built-in multi-protocol proxy support, enhanced message operations, multi-language translation and other extended functions. It supports multi-account management and privacy customization, meeting users' needs for Telegram client feature expansion and privacy protection.

metadata.name: tvbox
metadata.description: OK影视、tvbox配置文件，如果喜欢，请Fork自用。使用前请仔细阅读仓库说明，一旦使用将被视为你已了解。

summary.zh: 本仓库为TVBox、猫影视等影音应用的配置聚合资源库，整合多路开发者分享的点播源、直播线路、网盘授权规则，适配多端影音APP，仅供个人学习研究使用，使用者需自行承担相关风险。
summary.en: This repository is a configuration aggregation library for TVBox, CatVod and other video apps, integrating video-on-demand sources, live TV channels and cloud disk authorization rules shared by multiple developers, compatible with multi-terminal video applications, for personal learning and research only, with users bearing relevant risks at their own discretion.

metadata.name: NoMoreWalls
metadata.description: 自动抓取合并互联网上的公开节点。

summary.:: zh

metadata.name: Sandboxie
metadata.description: Sandboxie Plus & Classic

summary.zh: Sandboxie 是开源 Windows 沙箱隔离软件，通过虚拟化环境实现应用与宿主系统的安全隔离。支持不受信任程序运行、网页浏览及安全测试，不修改注册表与驱动器。提供现代 Qt UI（Plus）与经典界面（Classic）双版本，具备快照管理、便携模式等功能，适用于安全研究与日常防护。
summary.en: Sandboxie is an open-source Windows sandbox isolation software that creates virtualized environments to securely isolate applications from the host system. It supports untrusted program execution, web browsing, and security testing without modifying registry or drives. Available in Plus (modern Qt UI) and Classic editions, it features snapshot management, portable mode, and privacy controls for security research and daily protection.

metadata.name: awesome-cloudflare
metadata.description: ⛅️ 精选的 Cloudflare 工具、开源项目、指南、博客和其他资源列表。/ ⛅️ A curated list of Cloudflare tools, open source projects, guides, blogs and other resources.

summary.:: 本仓库是精选的 Cloudflare 生态开源资源列表，面向独立开发者，收录工具、指南、博客等资源，覆盖图床、对象存储、建站、运维等场景，多数工具基于 Cloudflare 无服务器架构，帮助开发者降本提效，支持多语言版本及在线导航。
summary.en: This repository is a curated list of high-quality open-source resources in the Cloudflare ecosystem, targeting independent developers. It collects practical tools, development guides, technical blogs and other resources, covering scenarios such as image hosting, object storage, site building, operation and maintenance, most of which are based on Cloudflare's serverless architecture, helping developers reduce costs and improve efficiency. It also supports multilingual versions and provides convenient online navigation, and is continuously updated.

metadata.name: ecs
metadata.description: VPS 融合怪服务器测评脚本 —— 更推荐使用无环境依赖的 Go 版本：https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs VPS Fusion Monster Server Test Script — we now recommend the Go version (zero external dependencies): https://github.com/oneclickvirt/ecs

summary.这是一款开源的VPS服务器综合测评Shell脚本，支持Ubuntu、Debian: 这是一款开源的VPS服务器综合测评Shell脚本，支持Ubuntu、Debian、CentOS等主流系统及多架构运行，无需root权限即可执行，提供硬件检测、网络测速、IP质量校验、回程路由测试等功能，支持交互与参数化无交互模式，Shell版本已停止新功能开发，相关功能已迁移至无环境依赖的Go版本。

metadata.name: proxypin
metadata.description: Open source free capture HTTP(S) traffic  software ProxyPin, supporting full platform systems

summary.:: ProxyPin是开源免费的跨平台HTTP(S)流量捕获工具，基于Flutter开发，支持Windows、Mac、移动端等全终端系统。具备流量拦截、重写、脚本处理、扫码连接、HAR导出等功能，可应用于抓包调试、API测试、移动端Flutter流量分析等场景，界面美观易用。
summary.en: ProxyPin is an open-source, free cross-platform HTTP(S) traffic capture tool built with Flutter, supporting all major operating systems including Windows, Mac and mobile terminals. It offers features like traffic interception, rewriting, script processing, QR-code connection and HAR export, applicable to packet debugging, API testing and Flutter mobile traffic analysis, with a beautiful and intuitive UI.

metadata.name: N3RD
metadata.description: CTV

summary.:: N3RD是轻量级开源计算机视觉工具库，提供常用CV算法的高效封装与实现，覆盖图像处理、目标检测等核心场景，大幅降低计算机视觉开发门槛，支持快速原型搭建与业务落地。
summary.en: N3RD is a lightweight open-source computer vision toolkit that provides efficient encapsulation and implementation of common CV algorithms, covering core scenarios such as image processing and object detection, greatly lowering the threshold for computer vision development, and supporting rapid prototyping and business deployment.

metadata.name: GOODBYEADS
metadata.description: 适用于AdGuard、Quantumult X、SmartDNS的去广告规则，合并优质上游规则并去重整理排列。

summary.:: GOODBYEADS是面向AdGuard、Quantumult X、SmartDNS等工具的聚合去广告规则集合，合并多源优质上游规则并去重优化，提供广告拦截、DNS拦截、白名单等多类规则，支持定时更新与国内加速订阅，累计超21万条拦截规则，可有效屏蔽网页、APP及智能电视广告。
summary.en: GOODBYEADS is an aggregated ad-blocking rule set compatible with tools like AdGuard, Quantumult X and SmartDNS. It merges and deduplicates high-quality upstream rules, providing ad-blocking, DNS interception and whitelist rules with scheduled updates and domestic accelerated subscriptions. With over 210k interception rules, it effectively blocks ads on web pages, apps and smart TVs.

metadata.name: FreeNodes
metadata.description: v2ray、clash免费节点爬虫，自动更新

summary.zh: 本仓库为AI驱动的v2ray/Clash免费代理节点自动爬虫工具，每日定时运行更新，聚合多源公开免费节点资源，提供标准订阅链接与稳定镜像加速地址，仅供学习交流使用。
summary.en: This repository is an AI-powered automated crawler designed for free V2Ray/Clash proxy nodes, which runs on a fixed daily schedule to automatically update and verify node resources. It aggregates free node resources from multiple public sources, provides standard subscription links and stable mirrored accelerated addresses for users, supports multiple node formats including V2Ray and Clash configurations, and all resources are for learning and communication use only, users can directly import the subscription links to their proxy clients for use.

metadata.name: adblockfilters
metadata.description: 去广告合并规则，每8个小时更新一次。

summary.zh: 本项目为自动更新的广告过滤规则库，每8小时同步上游规则源，经合并去重、DNS校验剔除无效域名后生成多版本规则，适配AdGuard、AdGuard Home、DNSMasq等主流工具，提供国内外加速节点及精简版，降低多设备部署成本。
summary.en: This project is an automatically updated ad filtering rule repository that syncs upstream rule sources every 8 hours. It generates multi-version rules after merging, deduplication and DNS validation to remove invalid domains, compatible with mainstream tools like AdGuard, AdGuard Home and DNSMasq, provides domestic and foreign acceleration nodes and lite versions to reduce multi-device deployment cost.

metadata.name: x-ui-yg
metadata.description: x-ui精简修改版脚本，支持Hysteria2、Xhttp传输协议、ENC加密、MLDSA65加密，集成argo固定临时双隧道（可共存）、Psiphon赛风VPN（30个国家）分流功能，支持部分节点聚合订阅、sing-box订阅、clash-meta订阅的配置输出

summary.zh: x-ui精简修改版一键部署脚本，支持Hysteria2、Xhttp等新型代理协议，集成Argo双隧道、Psiphon赛风VPN分流能力，可本地化生成多协议订阅配置，适用于VPS代理服务快速搭建与节点管理，兼容多架构多系统。
summary.en: A streamlined modified one-click deployment script for x-ui panel, supporting next-gen proxy protocols like Hysteria2 and Xhttp, integrating dual Argo tunnels and Psiphon VPN traffic splitting, capable of locally generating multi-protocol subscription configs, for rapid VPS proxy service setup and node management, compatible with multi-arch and multi-system.
tags_zh: 自动化部署与节点管理

metadata.name: mediago
metadata.description: Cross-platform video downloader — sniff and grab m3u8/HLS streams, Bilibili, YouTube and more. Desktop + Docker + 🦞.

summary.zh: MediaGo是跨平台视频下载工具，核心支持嗅探抓取m3u8/HLS流及B站、YouTube等上千站点视频，提供桌面端、Docker部署、浏览器插件、AI助手集成、HTTP API与内置格式转换能力，无需抓包或配置扩展即可快速完成视频下载。
summary.en: MediaGo is a cross-platform video downloader that supports sniffing and grabbing m3u8/HLS streams, as well as videos from over 1000 sites including Bilibili and YouTube. It offers desktop, Docker deployment, browser extension, AI assistant integration, HTTP API and built-in format conversion, enabling fast video download without packet capture or extension configuration.

metadata.name: TikTokDownloader
metadata.description: 抖音 / TikTok 平台作品下载/数据采集工具

summary.text: DouK-Downloader 是基于 Python 开发的抖音/TikTok 一站式内容下载与数据采集工具，支持视频/图集/直播拉流、账号作品批量下载、多格式数据持久化，提供 WebUI 交互界面，覆盖内容备份、运营数据采集、直播录制等场景，具备多线程、增量下载、代理支持等实用特性。

metadata.name: 1Panel
metadata.description: 🔥 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel and a lightweight AI management platform.

summary.zh: 1Panel是开源Linux服务器管理面板与轻量AI管理平台，面向全球250万+自托管用户，通过可视化界面提供服务器运维、AI模型与网关管理、一键建站、应用商店等一站式能力，GPLv3协议开源，大幅降低服务器与AI管理门槛。
summary.en: 1Panel is an open-source Linux server management panel and lightweight AI management platform, serving 2.5M+ self-hosters globally. It delivers one-stop server operations, AI gateway and model management, one-click website deployment, and an app store via an intuitive web interface, GPLv3 licensed, lowering barriers to server and AI management.

metadata.name: biliup
metadata.description: 自动直播录制、投稿、twitch、ytb频道搬运工具。命令行投稿(B站)和视频下载工具，提供多种登录方式，支持多p。边录边传0落盘

summary.zh: biliup是开源的直播录制与内容自动化工具，核心基于Rust开发，支持19个直播平台录制、弹幕抓取，可自动投稿至B站，实现边录边传0落盘，提供WebUI与命令行两种使用方式，支持24X7无人值守运行，还可封装为AI Agent技能，适用于UP主自动化内容生产、跨平台直播内容搬运等场景
summary.en: biliup is an open-source live streaming recording and content automation tool with Rust as the core development language. It supports recording and danmaku capturing for 19 live platforms, auto-upload to Bilibili, and features zero-disk recording with real-time upload. It offers both WebUI and CLI interfaces, supports 24/7 unattended operation, and can be packaged as an AI Agent skill, suitable for automated UP content production and cross-platform live content migration

metadata.name: anti-AD
